changelog: Update details: "Compatible up to" names the WordPress you run when it is a later point release of the version the plugin was tested with (tested with 7.1, running 7.1.4: 7.1.4), as WordPress.org does. The details popup no longer warns that the plugin was not tested with your version, and Dashboard > Updates no longer says its compatibility is unknown. A newer WordPress (7.2) still gets the warning.
Update details: each line of the changelog shows exactly as it was written. Before, a line naming a character code, such as the one for an apostrophe, showed the character instead of the code.
